items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Topics 1:1
items.html: The place of the three worlds BYA was made from the vessels of the back [Achoraim] of the Partzuf TNHY of AK, within which clothed the Partzuf of the Nekudim of SAG of AK: from the two lower thirds of Tifferet, down to the end of Tifferet, was made the place of the world of Beriah; from NHY was made the place of the world of Yetzirah; and from Malchut was made the place of the world of Assiyah. (Item 1).
